stem:
These photographs show a group of Chiricahua Apache students on their first day of school at the Carlisle Indian School and the same students four months later, 1886–1887.

These photographs provide evidence that one goal of the Carlisle Indian School was to —

options.label: F
options.text: restore U.S. citizenship to American Indians

options.label: G
options.text: encourage the study of American Indian religious practices

options.label: H
options.text: protect American Indians from nativist policies

options.label: J
options.text: assimilate American Indians into U.S. culture

visual_elements: Black and white photograph of Chiricahua Apache students on their first day at Carlisle Indian School
Black and white photograph of the same students four months later in different attire
